tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, hashlib, json, pathlib, os
R="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx"
P=R+"/plugins/system-spec-harness"
S=R+"/system-spec/spec-state.json"; F=R+"/system-spec/fetched-references.json"
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def run(argv):
    r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=R)
    return {"argv":argv,"exit_code":r.returncode,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr}
vcm=P+"/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py"; vsc=P+"/scripts/validate-source-citation.py"; vhs=P+"/scripts/validate-hearing-sources.py"
for p in [vcm,vsc,vhs]: print(p, os.path.exists(p), sha(p))
s0=sha(S); f0=sha(F)
res={}
res["c12_loop"]=run(["python3",vcm,S])
res["c12_rc"]=run(["python3",vcm,S,"--require-complete"])
res["c13"]=run(["python3",vsc,"--targets",S,"--references",F,"--state",S,"--repo-root",R])
res["hs"]=run(["python3",vhs,"--matrix",S,"--repo-root",R])
print("after", sha(S)==s0, sha(F)==f0, s0, f0)
print(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=False))
EOF
